test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Deliberate
solution: The correct answer is '**Planned**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Deliberate**' is '**Planned**'. • **Deliberate**: done on purpose; planned. (जान-बूझ कर किया हुआ; योजनानुसार) • *Example: Was it an accident or was it **deliberate**?* • **Planned**: to decide, organize or prepare for something you want to do in the future. (भविष्‍य के कामों के विषय में निर्णय करना, उन्‍हें व्‍यवस्थित या उनकी तैयारी करना; योजना बनाना) • *Example: to **plan** for the future...* **Correct Answer:__** *Planned.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Accidental**: happening by chance; not planned. (आकस्मिक; जिसकी कोई योजना न हो) • **Disastrous**: terrible, harmful or failing completely. (अनर्थकारी; दु:खद, विनाशकारी) • **Unplanned**: not planned. (अनियोजित, योजनारहित) 192:T6a6, The correct answer is '**drive**'.
